name: freeinference-companion
description: FreeInference Companion plugin for Codex: local lifecycle recording, rollout-backed context/cache reporting, provider diagnostics, and model discovery. It never proxies inference traffic. Community-built and unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FreeInference.

interface.shortDescription: FreeInference diagnostics and setup guidance for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Community-built Codex plugin with local lifecycle hooks, rollout-backed context and cache reporting, provider diagnostics, model discovery, and configuration guidance. Hooks record bounded local state, never proxy prompts, and add no inference requests.
defaultPrompt: Check FreeInference service status and provider configuration.
